name: quelltest
description: Free, offline gate for AI-written tests: proves tests fail when the code is wrong (mutation verification), detects weakened tests in a change, and finds untested risky edges in JavaScript and TypeScript.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/generator.js && node --check src/verification.js && node --check src/scan.js && node --check src/files.js && node --check src/unit.js && node --check src/synthesize.js && node --check src/runner.js && node --check src/ast.js && node --check src/backup.js && node --check src/handoff.js && node --check src/gate.js && node --check src/mcp.js && node --check src/routes.js && node --check src/mutate.js && node --check src/score.js && node --check src/diff.js && node --check src/sarif.js && node --check src/coverage.js && node --check src/cli-args.js && node --check scripts/verification-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/eval.mjs
scripts.test:ci: npm test && npm run test:verify && npm run check && npm run pack:check
